name: week
title: Product review
subtitle: Imported snapshots only. Verify coverage before using rates.

sections.title: Observed usage
sections.sql: select p.code,d.day,d.event_name,d.events,d.users from daily_usage d join projects p on p.id=d.project_id order by d.day,d.event_name

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select p.code,a.reference,a.rule,a.finding,a.owner from review_attention a join projects p on p.id=a.project_id order by p.code,a.rule

sections.title: Tracking defects
sections.sql: select p.code,q.event_name,q.distinct_id,q.property,q.finding from event_quality q join projects p on p.id=q.project_id order by p.code,q.event_name

sections.title: Event definitions
sections.sql: select p.code,t.name,t.owner,t.purpose,t.required_properties,t.review_on from event_types t join projects p on p.id=t.project_id order by p.code,t.name
